title: fix(plugin-form): a placed row editor is not nested in a form, and a save refused on placed lines marks their tab

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在“表头加明细”的录入表单里,明细表放在某个字段分组处时,展开一行明细编辑不再在开发控制台报“表单嵌套表单”的警告;分页签的表单里,保存被服务器以某一行明细为由拒绝时,明细所在的页签会像表头字段出错时一样标红点。
- 为什么做:这是“明细表放在字段分组处”那项工作(主从表单布局)评审时留下的两条收尾意见,补上明细出错时用户找不到原因的缺口。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是明细页签该标红没标、或多标了一个页签,保存本身照旧被拒、数据不会写错;整个改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

1. **Row editor in a placed slot (N2 of the L2 record on #36009).** `FormSlotPlacement` takes `ownsForm`: when its children already are a form of their own, it portals them into the slot with no wrapper form. The expanded row editor (an `ObjectForm`, its only other control a `type="button"`) is placed with `ownsForm`, so its form is no longer a React child of the slot's wrapper form, and React's DOM-nesting check stops logging "form cannot be a descendant of form". This is the measured S2 patch, re-applied on main (`git apply --check` clean, offsets +24/+78).
2. **Tab marker for a refused line (N3 of the L2 record, L1-c's nit).** A batch refusal is attributed to the placed collections it was refused on, using the same evidence the record page's `attributeRecordEditRefusal` reads: the operation the server names in `details.failedOperation.index` when it names one (a line's operation, never operation 0, the parent), else each field in `fields[]` that only line operations write. A field the parent operation carries stays the header form's to mark. `FormSlotStore` records those collection ids (`refuse(ids)`, cleared when the next save gets past validation, as the renderer clears its own markers). `TabbedForm` subscribes to the store and rebuilds its slot rows, each carrying `slotRefused` when its collection was refused. The form renderer's `erroredFieldTabs` marks the tab of a refused slot row with the treatment a refused header field gets (`data-error`, destructive text, the dot).

No export, prop or i18n key is added. `FormSlotHost` and `FormSlotRow` live in `formSlots.ts`, which `@object-ui/plugin-form` does not export. The renderer reads `slotRefused` off a `form-slot` row the same way it reads `slotRef`: a key only a host can produce.

## Tests

- `MasterDetailForm.groupPlacement-35889.test.tsx`, existing describe: an expanded row editor opens in the slot beside its collection, its inputs are owned by its own form, and no nesting warning is logged.
- Same file, new top-level describe (a refused save marks the tab of the placed lines it was refused on): a field only a line writes marks the lines tab and not the header tab; a server-named failed line operation marks the lines tab; control: a refusal on the header's own field marks its tab and leaves the lines tab unmarked.
- `formSlots.test.ts`: `refuse` marks the slot row until retired, de-duplicates, and an equal refusal emits nothing.

All readings at head `9ac514e3`.

## Acceptance notes

- The marker is the whole of the header-field treatment that applies here. A refused header field also activates its tab and focuses the field; a refused line does not switch tabs, because the renderer's catch runs before the host's refusal reaches the tab rows, and the lines show no per-row reason today (the master-detail form shows the refusal as the form's banner, as before). The acceptance names the marker only.
- A refusal that names neither a failed operation nor a field (a lock, a permission denial) is on no collection, and marks nothing, as before.
- File surface beyond the claim's wording: the tab marker is drawn by the form renderer (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`), not by `TabbedForm`, and the refusal travels through `formSlots.ts`. Both are named here.
- The editor's form still sits inside the header's form in the DOM (the slot element is inside it), as the lines' wrapper form already did; ownership is answered by the innermost form, which the pin asserts.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.groupPlacement-35889.test.tsx`: expect 11 tests passed.

Read first: (1) `MasterDetailForm.tsx` `refusedChildObjects` and its call in `sendBatch` (which refusals count as a line's); (2) `form.tsx` `erroredFieldTabs` (the renderer's new read); (3) `TabbedForm.tsx` the `useSyncExternalStore` on the slot host.
